summary: The Responses protocol of Meta's Model API in the fake API server, proved against Muse Code at the pinned version in namespaces of the case's own; the program is tests/cases/host/agentapi.sh

cases.behavior: Muse Code, in a fresh home and namespaces of the case's own, fetches the model catalog, then reads a file, runs a command, edits a file and commits over HTTPS, each a function of its namespace tool, signed in to the fake API server with a dummy key

execution.privileges: an ordinary user, root only in the user namespace it makes for its network
execution.cleanup: Muse, the server and every process they start, which end with the PID namespace the program makes; the homes, the clones and the authority's key, which the program removes; its logs under its scratch directory

assertions.checks: the case's network namespace has no interface but loopback, and an outside address is unreachable from it
muse --version is Muse Code 1.4.10-R6427.1, the version the case pins, whose file fetch_muse.sh checked by Meta's digest
the server played its six steps with six requests, each tool result as the script expects
the record is the model catalog and five turns over HTTPS
every request has the dummy key as its bearer token and the user agent of Muse at the pinned version
the history is the fixture's commit and Muse's, which changes greeting.txt alone, and the work tree is clean
Muse, the server and every process they started have ended, and the homes, the clones and the authority's key are removed

cases.behavior: the fake API server refuses Muse's tool result when notes.txt asks for another change, and the repository stays as it was
units: `tests/system/suites/museapi.sh`, the second run, with other notes

execution.privileges: an ordinary user, root only in the user namespace it makes for its network
execution.cleanup: Muse, the server and every process they start, which end with the PID namespace the program makes; the homes, the clones and the authority's key, which the program removes; its logs under its scratch directory

assertions.checks: the case's network namespace has no interface but loopback, and an outside address is unreachable from it
muse --version is Muse Code 1.4.10-R6427.1, the version the case pins, whose file fetch_muse.sh checked by Meta's digest

the server refuses the output of Muse's read of notes.txt, the first tool result, before Muse ends, and once the program has stopped Muse, which retries a refused request for minutes, the server's verdict fails
greeting.txt says hello, world, and the history is the fixture's commit alone
Muse, the server and every process they started have ended, and the homes, the clones and the authority's key are removed
